// diagnostic

E0944

Code that runs in the shipped program uses a name from a `#run use` import

What

Code that runs in the shipped program uses a name from a `#run use` import

Why

A `#run use` module exists only while building: its names work in compile-time code (a `#run { … }` block, a `#run fn`, a comptime argument, a value computed while building), and the shipped program leaves the module out

Fix

Import the module with plain `use` to use it at runtime, or move the reference into compile-time code, such as `NAME: #run value`.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0944: tests/ui/comptime_use_runtime_reference.stderr.

Error [jet.ComptimeImportAtRuntime]: `math` comes from a `#run use` import, but this code runs in the shipped program
  --> tests/ui/comptime_use_runtime_reference.jet:7:11
    |
  7 |     print(math.int_pow(2, 3))
    |           ^^^^
 Why: A `#run use` import exists only while building, so the shipped program does not contain its module
 Fix: Import it with plain `use`, or move this use into compile-time code: a `#run { … }` block, a `#run fn`, or a value computed while building
